title: Spanish Tortilla
subtitle: with slow-cooked potato and onion
description: A classic Spanish omelette of potatoes slowly cooked in olive oil with onion and set with eggs.

steps.text: Place the sliced potatoes and onion in a pot, cover with olive oil and cook over low heat for about 40 minutes until the potatoes are completely soft. Drain.
Whisk the eggs in a bowl and add the onion and potatoes.

Heat a little olive oil in a frying pan, pour in the egg, potato and onion mixture and fry over low heat for about 5 minutes until the edges are set. Flip using a plate or a pot lid and fry for another 8 minutes. Turn out onto a serving plate.
